title: Joomla Authentication
description: Enables the Joomla usersource option for single-signon with Joomla.

settings_def.name: enable_usersource
settings_def.label: Enabled
settings_def.description: Enable the app once you have verified all of your settings are correct.

settings_def.name: joomla_url
settings_def.label: Joomla URL
settings_def.description: This is the URL to your Joomla site (without any trailing slash).

settings_def.name: joomla_secret
settings_def.label: Joomla Secret
settings_def.description: Enter the Joomla Secret Key. This needs to be copied to the DeskPRO plugin on your Joomla site. In Joomla, go to Admin -> Extensions -> Plug-in Manager & Find "DeskPRO" and click on the title > Click on the "Basic Options" tab.

settings_def.name: lost_pwd_url
settings_def.label: Lost Password URL
settings_def.description: URL to give the user when they request a lost password.

settings_def.name: auto_agent
settings_def.label: Auto Agent
settings_def.checkbox_label: Automatically create agents if they do not already exist

inline_dependant.name: auto_agent_permission_group
inline_dependant.label: Add new agents to this permission group
